# FICSIT identification mark

FICSIT is the fictional company in Coffee Stain Studios' Satisfactory. Its mark
is used solely as in-world branding on the TeleportLogistics mod's buildings, at the user's
request. It is not TeleportLogistics's own logo and does not imply official endorsement.

The supplied alpha reference is the 2112 × 528 FICSIT mark retrieved from
https://www.satisfactoryplanner.net/images/ficsit-logo.png on 2026-09-13.
`Ficsit-outline.json` is a planar silhouette traced from that reference with
`scripts/prepare-brand-outline.py`. Coffee Stain's ownership of the mark is
unaffected. This source is separate from the SFUIKIT and original TeleportLogistics assets.
